ValidationRule.description: This validation rule checks that the Rejection Reason field is populated before the Lead status is changed to "Lost"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , OR ( ISCHANGED ( Status ), ISNEW() ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Lost'), ISBLANK( TEXT(PMC_SS_RejectionReason__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a “Rejection Reason” indicating why this Lead status is “Lost”
